Tools fixed (G11) and Calibration-3b passed gate v2; the agent looped on repeats because its transcript hid its own requests. G12 (echo, call counter, named rejection, truncation note) applied zero-API; gate v3 CG-12 catches the loop. Calibration-3c (protocol v3) next; MAIN_297 blocked until a separate decision after 3c.

calibration_3.finding: The transcript showed tool results but never the agent's own requests, and a rejected repeat added only 18 tokens, so at temperature 0 the model repeated itself (task 2 sent the same search 6 times). G12 restores the withheld information: action echo, call counter, named rejection, truncation note. Gate v3 CG-12 FAILS Calibration-3b prospectively (runs 1/6/4, share 0.524) and must PASS on Calibration-3c.

questions: What changed between Calibration-3b and after G12?
Why is fixing the loop not tuning?
When do the real comparisons start?

items.a: Nothing scientific: G12 is a prospective, label-blind scaffold amendment (D1 APPROVED, zero API). The agent now sees its own requests, a call counter, a named rejection, and a truncation flag — information the harness already had and withheld. Gate v3 CG-12 (no task with >= 3 consecutive rejected repeats) FAILS Calibration-3b (runs 1/6/4, share 0.524) as the RED proof.
items.ar: G12 بيعيد للـagent معلومات الـharness كان شايلها: هو طلب إيه، رقم النداء، سبب الرفض، وعلامة الاقتطاع. التعديل ببلind للـlabels وبيرجع معلومات موجودة أصلًا.

items.a: The loop was created by the harness: the transcript showed results but not the agent's own requests, and a rejection added only 18 tokens, so at temperature 0 the model repeated itself. Fixing it is label-blind and strengthens the competitor, which is conservative for our non-inferiority claim, and it is bounded (one preregistered amendment, D5).
items.ar: التكرار ده كان عيب في الـharness مش اختيار من الـmodel. إصلاحه بدون labels وبيعزز المنافس قبل المقارنة — اتجاه محافظ، وتعديل واحد مسجل مسبقًا.

items.a: After a clean Calibration-3c (protocol v3, gate v3, <= $0.25, not scored): MAIN_297 on 297 Saleor tasks, then predictions are frozen and scored with the preregistered delta=0.05 rule. Per D3 = MANUAL this mission STOPS after Calibration-3c; the MAIN_297 run needs a separate decision.
